## Publication Information

**Date:** 1882-3

**Genre:** Non-fiction: theology

**Publisher:** Not separately published

**Notes:** The <i>Watchword</i> was the journal of the Society of Watchers and Workers: An Association of Mutual Help and Service for Invalids, founded by Edith Sophia Jacob in 1879.  These articles may have been reprinted from elsewhere (perhaps from the <i>Monthly Paper of Sunday Teaching</i>?).
